name: Noise Bank
author: Emilie Gillet
description: Braids' three noise models in one slot: noise through a resonant filter, two resonant peaks, and a sample-and-hold whose random sequence loops into a pitched buzz.

controls.label: Model
controls.description: Selects filtered noise, twin peaks, or clocked noise.

controls.label: Colour
controls.description: Resonance for the two filtered models; loop length of the random sequence for the clocked one.

controls.label: Shape
controls.description: Lowpass to bandpass to highpass, the second peak's interval, or the number of sample-and-hold levels.

controls.label: Drive
controls.description: Pushes the output through the module's overdrive shaper, or backs it out into the clean part of the curve.

outputs.aux: Its fixed complement: the notch, the peak difference, or a second sequence. The stereo toggle does not change this pair.

trigger: Reseeds and restarts only the Clocked model's looping sequence; Filtered and Twin Peaks keep running.
